messages:
Alex: quick q — we're planning to remove implicit default fallback on /v1/generate (i.e., if no X-Model-Pin header, we stop routing to a mutable 'default'). who needs to be looped in and what do we need to verify before announcing?

Marta: product: +1 on a staged deprecation. proposal: 6w runway: 2w notice, 2w SDK/docs, 2w enforcement. also want a clear migration guide and in-console banner.

Sam: eng-platform: current flow: no X-Model-Pin -> gateway tags request as unpinned -> routes to alias 'default'. proposed change: require explicit pin or X-Accept-Model-Version header; keep an opt-in "allow_unpinned" flag for legacy enterprise deployments. quick checklist:
- ensure gateway passes any model headers through (nginx/ingress)
- add telemetry metric for unpinned requests (metric: api.requests.unpinned)
- server-side validation: 400 when missing after enforcement window
- canary toggle per region

Jordan: sdk: we can ship a deprecation warning in SDK first (minor). sample patch:
```python
# new param name: model_pin (optional)
client.generate(prompt, model_pin=None)  # warns when None after date
```
We should avoid a major semver if possible; warn -> soft error -> hard error. need to coordinate dates.

Nina: docs: I'll draft migration guide + FAQ. need exact header names and example error responses. do we return 400 or 409 for missing pin? prefer 400 + structured body {"error_code":"unplaced_model_pin","reason":"..."}. also will add a small curl example.

Product Ops: announcement plan: changelog + email to workspace owners + console banner 2w before enforcement. also check enterprise contracts for pinned-model guarantees (cc legal later).

deploy-bot: canary flags: allow_unpinned: us-east-1=true, eu-west-1=true, ap-south-1=false (as of this morning).

Sam: additional items for infra:
- add server-side header to indicate route used: X-Served-Model: redwood/rlhf-1.3
- add rollout toggle: featureflag.allow_unpinned (RBAC to flip)
- add smoke test that sends unpinned traffic through canary and verifies response shape

Jordan: SDK specifics:
- emit console warning on client init if model_pin omitted and date > warning_date
- add helper method client.suggest_pin(prompt_set) ? (we can discuss later)
- patch ready in 2 business days if we get header names and timeline

Alex: quick sample we can put in docs (Nina, feel free to copy):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "X-Model-Pin: redwood/rlhf-1.3" \
  -d '{"prompt":"Hello"}'
```
If missing after enforcement window we'll return 400 + body: {"error_code":"unplaced_model_pin","message":"model pin required; see docs: https://console.redwood.ai/docs/migration"}

Marta: timeline suggestion again:
- Week 0: announce & docs draft
- Week 1-2: SDK warning release + banner in console
- Week 3-4: optional enforcement in canary regions (ap-south off)
- Week 5-6: global enforcement

Sam: Tests to add:
- e2e: unpinned request => routed to alias before enforcement
- regression: pinned requests still return identical response shape and headers
- perf: make sure batching logic unaffected by header check

Nina: I'll need example payloads for the error and success cases. Sam/Jordan please drop them here and I'll start the doc.

Product Ops: notify: support, account mgmt, legal (for enterprise customers). create a short FAQ for CS.

Alex: action items (owners):
- Sam: infra gating + canary flags + add telemetry (ETA: 1977776220)
- Jordan: SDK warning + patch + release notes (ETA: 1977776400)
- Nina: migration guide + curl examples (ETA: 1977776500)
- Marta: comms + banner + customer list (ETA: 1977776600)
- Product Ops: support FAQ + legal check (ETA: 1977776600)

Sam: I'll create the infra PR and link the canary dashboard. attaching quick checklist in PR description.

Alex: perfect. if nobody objects, we'll treat this as 'ack' and start the work. :thumbsup:

Marta: ack.

Jordan: ack, will drop SDK diff by EOD.

Nina: ack, starting doc now.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary update at 1977776100: allow_unpinned -> false in ap-south-1 (pending PR).
